purpose: Audit all previously 25 unknown model parameter totals using publisher first-party model cards/papers and one official deployment partner. Preserve strict >=150B exclusion and state when component counts are incomplete.
criteria: Promote to PASS only when source supplies a count for a named published model or a clearly itemized set of its main inference weights and indicates a margin far below 150B. Explicitly keep dependencies and exact tensor census as further separate pre-download checks. For partial core-only numbers or activated-vs-total ambiguity, retain UNVERIFIED_BLOCK_FINAL_LOCK.
